fit_reason: Whole 2019 Toyota Corolla sedan listed by a private owner in cars by owner.
findings: Paint looks generally clean and glossy across the hood, sides and trunk, with no obvious oxidation visible
Wet spots and drips on the pavement under the front and rear suggest a recent wash; possible light water spotting on the dark grey paint is hard to confirm from these photos
Light dust and smudging visible on the center console and piano-black trim around the radio and shifter
Front lower grille and bumper area look slightly dull compared to the body paint
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Corolla SE and it already looks well kept. A pre-sale interior wipe-down to clear the dust on the center console and shiny trim, plus a wax to give the grey paint some extra depth in photos, could help it stand out. We're a local detailing team and come to you. Would you like a quote?
